Package arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters

Class RequestIdaParameter

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Parameter
arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters.RequestIdaParameter
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class RequestIdaParameter
extends Parameter
This class is used to pass details to request an IDA of an ELGA area. This IDA could be used to register in ELGA. This method is only possible for hospitals as health care provider.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
